acceptance_predicates.description: Omitted, explicit, and unavailable channel launch paths retain the resolved channel and typed diagnostics in human and --json output.
Unsafe environment roots remain rejected and development-only authentication, signatures, and key management remain warning-only.
The receipt identifies exact ASB and paired TUI heads and hosted checks.

definition_of_done: Launch repair is reviewed and exact-head checks pass.
Independent review confirms no environment or development-mode gate was weakened.

inputs.description: Exact ASB/TUI product heads and launch fixtures.

outputs.description: Human and JSON launch diagnostic receipt.

gates.description: Real subprocess and PTY launch cases pass at the exact reviewed head.
